paper.abstract_en: The purpose of this work is to bring gravitational theories into play within the quickly developing framework of factorization algebras. We fit the causal structure of Lorentzian manifolds into categorical language, and in the globally hyperbolic case discover a convenient equivalence of coverages. Then, we show how both perturbative general relativity and perturbative conformal gravity define Batalin-Vilkovisky classical field theories. Finally, we describe how the observables of linearized general relativity define a particularly nice factorization algebra on the category of Ricci flat globally hyperbolic manifolds and present a few conjectures which arise in specific cases, primarily motivated by the study of black hole entropy as a conserved Noether charge.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文将引力理论纳入因子代数框架，构造了洛伦兹流形因果结构的范畴化表述，并证明微扰广义相对论与微扰共形引力定义Batalin-Vilkovisky经典场论；随后在线性化广义相对论中给出Ricci平坦整体双曲流形范畴上的因子代数，并以黑洞熵作为守恒Noether荷提出若干猜想。理论构造层次深、方法结构清晰，且同时触及引力基础与黑洞热力学，值得跟进阅读。
decision.title_zh: 线性化引力的因子代数
decision.abstract_zh: 本工作的目的是将引力理论带入正在快速发展的因子代数框架之中。我们将洛伦兹流形的因果结构融入范畴语言，并在整体双曲情形下发现了一种方便的覆盖等价性。然后，我们展示微扰广义相对论和微扰共形引力如何定义Batalin-Vilkovisky经典场论。最后，我们描述线性化广义相对论的观测量如何在Ricci平坦整体双曲流形范畴上定义一个特别好的因子代数，并提出若干在具体情形中出现的猜想，这些猜想主要由将黑洞熵作为守恒Noether荷的研究所激发。
